artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan: audit and record the time-shift consumer invariant, propagate it to two READMEs, relocate the StarValidIn adapters, extend the C14 baseline, add TM-star theorem-index rows with their Paper: anchors, and run the full gate.

memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic, adding a row to docs/theorem-index.md is a three-part obligation, not a one-file edit. scripts/check-module-invariants.sh C15's second assertion requires the row's named declaration to carry a `Paper: <anchor>` or `Paper: - (reason)` line in its own /-- doc comment, so rows drag docstring edits into files outside the nominal territory. The Axioms cell reading `pinned:C14` requires matching entries appended, in the same order, to BOTH the C14_BASELINE (C14BASE) and C14LEAN heredocs. Critically, C14 filters `lake env lean` output through `grep 'depends on axioms'`, so a declaration whose #print axioms prints 'does not depend on any axioms' (typical for inductives) contributes to neither side -- writing a fabricated baseline line for it is a hard C14 failure. Always measure with the real pipeline before writing a baseline line. And an OPEN result cannot be a row at all: C15's ROW regex requires a backticked fully-qualified FormalSystem.* name, so open statuses go in the prose section 'Statuses that are refutations, not gaps'.
